chapter: Luck, tricks and the Bourbon Street job
title: Speck's rise from sandwich wagons to dance promoter
summary: Speck sold sandwiches to mill construction workers, ran slot machines, got rich, lost money to his wife's suit and turned to running dances, earning over a hundred thousand in wartime.
